sloka: कुम्भश्चैव निकुम्भश्च राक्षसौ भीमदर्शनौ ।दिष्ट्या तौ निहतौ राम कुम्भकर्णसुतौ मृधे ।। ७.१.२४ ॥
transliteration: kumbhaścaiva nikumbhaśca rākṣasau bhīmadarśanau ।diṣṭyā tau nihatau rāma kumbhakarṇasutau mṛdhe ।। 7.1.24 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, it is by good fortune that you have killed Kumbha and Nikumbha, the two sons of Kumbhakarna who were of terrible appearance, in battle.
